title: K1: launcher records clean-start source metadata (incl. platform and toolchain) and the host serves raw results.json
outcome: Every launcher results.json carries a clean-start source block {commit, tree, clean, platform, launcherVersion, toolchain} from pinned Git and its own preflight, and GET /api/test-runs/{run_id}/results returns the original results.json bytes with sha256 and size (named 413 above 1 MiB), host-neutral for the Mac and Windows B.
acceptance: Launcher tests show the source block on a main worktree and a linked worktree with the exact commit and tree; a dirty start records clean:false; no Git yields an explicit unknown; toolchain records {cargoVersion, rustcVersion, source, rustupOverride} from the launcher's own preflight; platform names the host OS.

Route tests show GET /api/test-runs/{run_id}/results returns the stored results.json bytes unchanged with their sha256 and size, refuses an unknown run with a named error, and refuses a file above 1 MiB with a named 413; the route is read-only.
The full gate passes on the exact final input that lands, with an independent review pair and no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding on that input.
